title: 5 Claude Cheat Codes That Save Hours of Work
description:
Discover five "cheat codes" for Claude Coer that will significantly boost your productivity. See how claude cowork can process meeting recordings into actionable items and automate task assignments, streamlining your meeting management. These claude skills are powerful workflow automation tools that enhance your ai automation capabilities.

Here are five things Claude can work and do
that most people have no idea about.
Drop a meeting recording into a folder
and Claude turns it into action items,
assigns them by a person,
and creates a tracking spreadsheet
all automatically.
Number two,
point it at a folder with 200 files
and Claude renames, sorts, and organizes
every single one.
You just describe the pattern once
and it handles the rest.
Number three,
ask Claude to research any topic
and instead of giving you a text response,
it creates an actual PowerPoint presentation
with slides that are saved to your desktop.
Number four,
give Claude a messy spreadsheet
and it cleans up the data,
fixes the formulas,
and formats everything into a report
that you can actually send.
And number five,
set up a scheduled task
and Claude does it automatically
every morning, every week,
whenever you need.
Your computer just has to be on.
So, comment workflow
and I'll send you the link to try it yourself.
